description: What a work item or pull request is, or who takes it: classification, never position or hold. Also the request that asks for promotion. A working group's own label is its charter's group_label, not a term here.
name: work_label

terms.description: Asks for the promote transition; board-sync makes it.
terms.label: Promote request

terms.description: Something does not work. Bugs ride their own track, never the Ready feed, and are never weaker than P1.
terms.label: Bug

terms.description: A tracking item whose sub-issues are the work.
terms.label: Epic

terms.description: A design brief, not a work item.
terms.label: Plan

terms.description: A user-facing story that work serves.
terms.label: User story

terms.description: Routines may run it without the owner present.
terms.label: Unattended lane

terms.description: Derived priority P0; never set by hand.
terms.label: Priority P0

terms.description: Derived priority P1; never set by hand.
terms.label: Priority P1

terms.description: Derived priority P2; never set by hand.
terms.label: Priority P2

terms.description: On the critical path of a ranked change: raises derived priority one tier.
terms.label: Critical path

terms.description: Blocks a gate: raises derived priority one tier.
terms.label: Blocks a gate

terms.description: Something that worked broke: raises derived priority one tier.
terms.label: Regression

terms.description: Closed as completed with no code change.
terms.label: No code

terms.description: The owner asks the group reviewer to look at a pull request again.
terms.label: Review requested
